This place fixes burnout.

Bãi biển Lumera Beach sits right on Trần Hưng Đạo, but the second you step onto the sand it doesn't feel like a main-strip beach. Calm water. Soft light in the late afternoon. The kind of quiet that makes you forget your phone exists.

4.5 stars. 98 reviews. Still not overrun.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
